economy.label: Economy
economy.description: Virtual currency, earnings, leaderboard and role shop.

daily.cooldown: ⏳ You already claimed your reward. Come back {time}.

shop.title: 🛒 Role shop
shop.unavailable: ❌ This item is no longer available.
shop.cannotAssign: ⚠️ I can't assign this role (permission or hierarchy).
shop.tooPoor: ❌ Too expensive: {price} but you only have {balance}.

currencyName.label: Currency name
currencyName.help: The currency's name, plural, as it appears in all of the bot's messages. Purely cosmetic: changing it does not touch balances.

currencySymbol.label: Currency symbol
currencySymbol.help: The symbol shown next to amounts. A server emoji is written in its full `<:name:id>` form — if it is later deleted from the server, that code shows as-is instead of the image.

messageMin.label: Minimum earned per message
messageMin.help: The floor of the random amount paid for each counted message. The randomness stops anyone working out exactly how many messages buy a role.

messageMax.label: Maximum earned per message
messageMax.help: The ceiling of that same roll. Weigh it against your shop prices: the ratio between the two decides how long it takes to afford anything.

messageCooldown.label: Cooldown between gains (s)
messageCooldown.help: During this delay, further messages from the same member pay nothing. At 0, ten one-word messages pay ten times, and the economy rewards noise.

dailyAmount.label: Amount of the /daily command
dailyAmount.help: What the daily reward pays, claimable once a day. It is the baseline income: a member who only claims it should progress, but slowly, otherwise writing stops being worth anything.

voiceEnabled.label: Earnings in voice channels
voiceEnabled.help: Also pays for time spent in voice channels. A member alone, deafened or muted earns nothing: otherwise leaving a tab open overnight would be enough to get rich.

voicePerMinute.label: Earned per minute in voice
voicePerMinute.help: What each minute spent in voice with company pays. Mind the accumulation: sixty minutes of idling in voice should not be worth a day of writing.

ignoredChannelIds.label: Ignored channels
ignoredChannelIds.help: No income is counted there, by message or in voice. Keep it for bot, test and spam channels — anywhere writing a lot means nothing.

ignoredRoleIds.label: Ignored roles
ignoredRoleIds.help: Members holding any of these roles stop earning. Useful for secondary bots, and the quietest sanction against someone inflating their balance.

leaderboardChannelId.label: Leaderboard channel
leaderboardChannelId.help: The bot keeps a single richest-members leaderboard message there, rewritten periodically rather than reposted. Empty, there is no standing leaderboard — the command still works.

g1.label: 🏪 Role shops
g1.description: Each shop sells roles for the server's currency.

shops.label: Shops
shops.help: One shop per row, 25 items each, where ROLES are bought with the currency. The bot must be able to grant those roles: they have to sit BELOW its own, otherwise the purchase charges the member and then fails to give them anything. A stock of -1 is unlimited, 0 shows the item as sold out.
